subject: Action required: your Ampvale power bank refund (case AMP-R-70412)
body:
Dear Ampvale customer,

Our records show that a power bank purchased with your email address is included in the Ampvale Pocket 10K recall (case AMP-R-70412).

To receive your refund of $49.99, confirm your identity and the card used for the original purchase within 48 hours:

http://ampvale-refunds.com/claim?case=AMP-R-70412

Claims that are not verified within 48 hours will be closed and will no longer be eligible for a refund.

Ampvale Recall Center
